content.short: Ink Finance provides a flexible framework for on-chain financial governance and management.
content.description: Ink Finance provides a complete set of financial management tools wrapped in a governance framework. The financial core and the governance layer are comprehensive and highly customizable. The protocol can be used by crypto-native ecosystems, such as KOL/influencer investment clubs for fundraising, game-fi ecosystems for treasury and asset management with integrity and transparency, DeFi protocols for risk management and fund pooling to support main pool liquidity, and RWA originators for compliance in token minting and fundraising.
content.meta: Ink Finance offers a complete set of on-chain financial tools within a governance framework. Discover Ink Finance and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
